mapper.select: select e.id, e.code, e.name, e.sort_no, e.remark, e.create_time, e.update_time, e.deleted, (select count(*) from server s where s.env = e.code and s.deleted = 0) as server_count, (select count(*) from app_instance i where i.env_code = e.code and i.deleted = 0) as instance_count from environment e where e.deleted = 0 order by e.sort_no, e.id
select id, code, name, sort_no, remark, create_time, update_time, deleted from environment where code = #{code} and deleted = 0
mapper.update: update environment set name = #{name}, remark = #{remark} where id = #{id} and deleted = 0
